rows.claim: Finite chirality criterion, with all listed tests and both directions
rows.independent_note: Both directions checked: exact C+ marking, rank at least three, coset geometry/flag extension hypothesis. One truncation and exact two-coset fiber imply two free orbits; proper flags, thinness and all residues are then proved. Finite product-size statement agrees with the source after inversion converts right to left cosets.

rows.claim: For infinite groups use exact two-coset fiber; numerical cardinal equality alone is insufficient
rows.independent_note: Infinite cardinal division is not used. Equal countably infinite cardinalities do not determine a coset count (Z over 3Z already has three cosets). The exact fiber formulation is the accepted infinite qualification, not a proof of the unrestricted literal cardinal test.

rows.claim: Panel stabilizers trivial from the stated C+ intersection condition
rows.independent_note: Successively intersect complementary supports. The first singleton support gives the identity, so every panel stabilizer is trivial. Nonidentity independent marking and rank restriction remain stated.

rows.claim: One truncation plus two-coset fiber implies transitivity on every proper flag type
rows.independent_note: Normalize any chamber to C or D_k; for a proper flag choose a missing type i and use a_ki D_k=D_i. Its retained coordinates lie in C. All steps use actual chambers.

rows.claim: Exactly two completions per panel, including for infinite G
rows.independent_note: Each orbit has at most one completion of a fixed panel because its stabilizer is trivial; C and D_i provide both. Valid for infinite G.

rows.claim: Connected residues, with actual second matching in ranktwo
rows.independent_note: For residues of rank at least three the internal coset graph is only a spanning subgraph and its parabolic subgroups generate. For rank two the identity matching alone is insufficient; the a_uv matching connects the cyclic coordinate, also for infinite order.

rows.independent_note: The union of the C and D_0 orbits is adjacency closed in both directions. Chamber connectedness makes it exhaustive; panel stabilizer triviality makes the two orbits distinct. This closes the designated/full action bridge.
